ai.headline: A steady plank with locked arms and a mostly straight body line, but your head hangs down and your hips ride a little high early in the hold.
good: Arms are stacked with shoulders over hands and elbows locked straight through all frames.
Legs stay straight with no knee bend from the first frame to the last.
The line from shoulders through hips to ankles stays close to a straight line across the whole 30 seconds.
No collapse at the end: frames 6 to 8 show the same body position as frames 2 to 4, so you held your shape.

fix.issue: Your head hangs down with the chin tucked toward the chest in all frames, most obvious in frames 1 to 3, so the neck is bent instead of long.
fix.cue: Look at the floor just past your hands and make a long neck, like a double chin and not a nod.

fix.issue: Your hips sit slightly high in frames 1 to 5, so the body makes a shallow pike rather than one straight line.
fix.cue: Squeeze your glutes and lower your hips until ears, shoulders, hips and heels line up.

ai.over_time: The setup in frame 1 is already a real plank, not a transition. The head stays dropped the whole way through. The hips sit a touch high in frames 1 to 5 and settle closer to a straight line by frames 6 to 8, with no sag or collapse at the end.
ai.next_set: Set your head and hip height before the timer starts, then keep that same shape to the last second.
cannot_judge: Core bracing, rib position and breathing, because the loose sweater hides your midsection.
Whether your lower back arches or stays flat, since the dark trousers and sweater hide the curve.
Shoulder blade position and whether the shoulders creep up toward your ears.
Whether your toes are tucked and gripping or your feet are resting another way, as the feet sit near the right edge.

ai.spoken: Solid plank, and you held it to the end. Two things to clean up. First, your head hangs down the whole time, chin tucked to your chest. Lift your gaze to the floor just past your hands and keep your neck long, like you're making a double chin, not a nod. Second, your hips sit a bit high early on, so you're in a slight pike. Squeeze your glutes and lower your hips until your body's one straight line from ears to heels. Next set, check your head and hips right after setup, then hold.
